t: Section 103(a) (4) of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965 (title II of Public Law 874, 81st Congress, as amended) is amended by inserting “except paragraph (5),” after “this subsection,”.

fable.w: This section is a purely technical amendment that inserts a cross-reference exception into an existing provision of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act. A tempting reading is that an education statute implies coordination with state or local educational agencies, but nothing in this text provides for consultation, hearings, rulemaking, advisory bodies, or a right to sue. No party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision here.
fable.s: is amended by inserting “except paragraph (5),” after “this subsection,”
